verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party capability to export all account or project data in open formats for migrating away. The closest items are adjacent: Log Drains for longer log retention, the REST API and OpenAPI spec as developer building blocks, and container and Build Output API portability. None of these is a documented full-data export, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
